svg.text: Nearby Friends Evolution: 2021 Default vs. 2026 Modern Standard
From Legacy ZooKeeper-Ring Redis 6 Pub/Sub & Exact Distance Leaks to Valkey 9 SPUBLISH, WebTransport & Anti-Trilateration Privacy
Architectural Dimension
2021 Textbook Baseline (ByteByteGo Ch. 17)
2026 Production Standard (Cloud-Native & Privacy-Safe)
1. Pub/Sub Routing &
Cluster Coordination
140 Standalone Redis 6 nodes + external ZooKeeper hash ring
Required custom ZK ring client because Redis 6 Cluster PUBLISH
broadcast every message across the cluster bus to all N nodes
Valkey 9 / Redis 7+ Sharded Pub/Sub (SPUBLISH / SSUBSCRIBE)
Native hash-slot-scoped Pub/Sub with multi-threaded I/O eliminates
O(N) cluster-bus broadcast and external ZooKeeper ring management
2. Client Transport &
Battery Adaptation
Fixed 30-second TCP WebSocket GPS polling loop
TCP head-of-line blocking on cellular handoffs; transmits every
30 seconds even when user phone lies stationary on a desk
HTTP/3 WebTransport (QUIC Datagrams) + Motion-Gated Cadence
0-RTT connection migration across Wi-Fi/5G; on-device IMU motion
co-processor suppresses GPS uploads when stationary (cuts QPS 60%)
3. Spatial Grid for
Random Discovery
Rectangular Geohash channel pool (9-cell subscription)
Diagonal corner neighbors sit sqrt(2) = 1.414x farther than edge
neighbors; severe latitude cell-width distortion toward poles
Uber H3 Hexagonal Channel Pool (1 + 6 gridDisk(1) = 7 cells)
Equidistant center-to-center distance across all 6 hex neighbors
with 22% fewer channel subscriptions per user (7 vs 9 channels)
4. Anti-Stalking &
Trilateration Defense
Raw exact distance / coordinates returned to friend clients
Vulnerable to 3-point trilateration: an attacker spoofing 3 GPS
locations intersects 3 distance circles to pinpoint exact house
0.5-Mile Distance Bucketing + Planar Laplace Noise + Ghost Mode
Server quantizes distances (>= 0.5 mi floor), adds differential
privacy geo-indistinguishability noise, and detects spoof velocity
5. Location History
Storage & Tiering
Unbounded raw Cassandra tables on local NVMe disks
28.8B rows/day (~1 TB/day) accumulates multi-petabyte NVMe costs
and compaction overhead without automated cold-storage offload
ScyllaDB TWCS (7-Day Hot TTL) -> Iceberg / GeoParquet on S3
Time-Window Compaction drops expired SSTables in O(1); long-term
ML trajectories compacted into Zstd GeoParquet with GDPR TTLs
Key Architectural Takeaway: Why Nearby Friends Is CPU-Bound on Pub/Sub Fan-Out, Not Memory-Bound
• Memory for 100M channels and 400M subscriber pointers is only ~200 GB (2 servers), but 333.3k writes/s x 40 online friends = 13.33M (~14M) pushes/s.
• At ~100k pushes/s per core, fan-out requires 134–140 Pub/Sub nodes — and you MUST use Sharded Pub/Sub (SPUBLISH) or an etcd Consistent Hash Ring
so legacy Redis Cluster PUBLISH does not broadcast 333.3k writes/s across all 140 nodes (46.7M cluster-bus messages/sec).
